test_assignment.rule: freeze every complete signer in test_hierarchy; never release a test-hierarchy signer into development

development_policy.if_s3_incomplete: skip Stage 3; any verified non-test S3 clips may augment training
development_policy.other_incomplete_non_test_signers: verified clips and original isolated clips may augment training

obsolete_split: configs/signer_split.json puts S5 and S14 in train and must not be used for Version 2

annotation_gate.agreement: same canonical class and temporal IoU >= 0.5, else adjudication
annotation_gate.manual_insert_policy: a pass-1 discovery missed by the detector remains flagged as manual_insert and receives pass-2 verification; it is not described as independently discovered
annotation_gate.annotation_boundary_rule: start at first intentional movement into the sign; end after the final intentional hold or motion, before transition to the next sign

feature_extraction.frame_sampling: uniform temporal bin centers over the frozen manual bounds
feature_extraction.hand_selection: highest handedness-classification confidence, with image/world landmark indices kept paired

model_training.encoder: one-layer bidirectional LandmarkBiLSTM with temporal mean pooling and layer normalization

isolated_task: 49-way classification given an isolated, manually bounded gesture from an unseen signer. Not spotting, continuous recognition, or live webcam accuracy.

estimand.primary: mean across seeds of the equal-weight mean of per-signer macro-recall
estimand.within_signer_rule: use every verified clip; compute recall within each class, then average the 49 classes equally
estimand.seed_aggregation: compute the primary independently for seeds 17, 42, 73; report mean and sample SD across seeds
estimand.uncertainty_interpretation: seed SD describes optimization variation only; it is not a confidence interval for a signer population
estimand.batch: one evaluation-only batch from three frozen checkpoints; no retraining or adaptation afterward

stage2.name: data_only_s1_s2_diagnostic
exclude_from_train: the fold held-out signer from every source
stage2.compare_to: 59.4% ± 3.3% prototypical xyz+angles on 375 isolated clips, heldout_s1 / heldout_s2

trials.description: wrist-centered, palm-scale-normalized image xyz plus 20 joint angles and a detection flag
MediaPipe world landmarks, wrist-centered and scaled by wrist-to-middle-MCP distance, plus a detection flag
world_xyz rotated into orthonormal palm axes defined by wrist, middle MCP, index MCP, and pinky MCP, plus a detection flag

stage3.selection_metric: mean across seeds and S1/S2/S3 LOSO folds of per-signer 49-class macro-recall using every evaluation clip
stage3.if_s3_incomplete: skip architecture search; carry Stage 2 spec

stage4_final_test.primary: all-clips hierarchical macro-recall: clips within class, classes within signer, signers within seed, then mean across seeds
stage4_final_test.descriptive_not_causal: A prepared vs unprepared accuracy gap is not a causal environment effect.

fallback_paper: If fewer than two complete 49-way testers: V1 exploratory benchmark plus the verified annotation resource. No confirmatory 49-way claim.
